description: CA Forest Wildfire (1985-2022) is a dataset listed in Open Government portal of Canada, an open data portal, published or maintained by Natural Resources Canada | Ressources naturelles Canada. Wildfire change year 1985-2022. Wildfire changes occurred from 1985 to 2022 displaying the year of greatest wildfire disturbance. It is developed within the framework of Canada’s National Terrestrial Ecosystem Monitoring System (NTEMS). Coverage: Canada. The portal files it under the publisher Natural Resources Canada | Ressources naturelles Canada. The licence is Open Government Licence - Canada (as labelled on the portal).
